title: Treadwear Claim Terms by Tire Line — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Schedule of treadwear claim terms, Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The figures below govern how a worn tire is assessed for a prorated treadwear adjustment on each line.

| Line | Price the percentage is taken of | Minimum adjustment percentage | Inspection usable for | Adjustments per wheel position |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | original price per tire on the set's ticket | 10% | 30 days | 1 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | original price per tire on the set's ticket | 10% | 30 days | 1 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date | 10% | 30 days | 1 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date | 8% | 30 days | 1 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date | 5% | 30 days | 1 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date | 5% | 30 days | 1 |

Terms common to every line:

- **Rounding of the adjustment percentage:** rounded down to a whole percent (floor to the whole percent) on all six lines.
- **Wear patterns that exclude an adjustment:** irregular alignment wear, irregular inflation wear and damage, on all six lines.
- **Records that must be on file:** the purchase ticket and the rotation records, on all six lines.
- **Inspection usable for:** 30 calendar days from the inspection date on all six lines.
- **Adjustments per wheel position:** 1 over the life of the warranty on all six lines.

**Minimum percentage, both sides (hypothetical percentages):** on a line whose minimum is 10%, a computed 10% may be issued and a computed 9% may not; on the Highway Terrain LT 65K line (8%), 8% may be issued and 7% may not; on the 75K and 85K lines (5%), 5% may be issued and 4% may not.
